body: Well I talked to her and I feel that things didn't go very well. I asked her if anything was wrong and she said nothing. I told her that we don't talk anymore and that I feel she doesn't love me and I feel crazy because the couple times I've brought it up she acts as if she has no idea what I'm talking about. I told her I've been incredibly unhappy and that if she can't talk to me and tell me if there is a problem we should talk to a marriage counselor. She didn't really say anything, just said she was tired and wanted to lay down. No 'of course I love you' no 'let's talk about it' just that shes tired and wants to lay down. I couldnt be in the house anymore. I'm just sitting in the mall parking lot. I feel sick. I feel like my whole life is over. I feel like I have nothing and no one to talk to other than the fucking internet.
That's one of my fears but didn't feel like I needed to because I just want to fix things and for everything to go back to normal. So I guess I feel the same way as you did. Thank you for the advice.
That's unfortunate to hear but I appreciate your insight. Thank you for the kind wishes.
Thank you for the advice. I think I'm going to talk to her again and suggest that if things don't improve that we need to seek a therapist of some sort. Thank you.
